formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (s : Fin n → Bool) (T' : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ → PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (G.deleteEdges (((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C) : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n))) : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))) T' → ((PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C)).card + (G.edgeFinset \ (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).biUnion (PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE G C)).card + T'.card + (PEqualNP.Core.maximalCores G C).card ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: G is a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle. C has AND and OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, so it reads only earlier wires, computes the edge function of G, and is a lift fixed point. With U, D, mc as for the core-cover row and tau(G - D) the least size of a vertex cover of G with the edges of D removed: |U| + (number of edges of G not in D) + tau(G - D) + mc <= (number of gates of C) + 1; that is, the gates outside the maximal cores' cones pay the two-level count of the edges the cores do not accept.
title: Rest bound: at a lift fixed point of a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for a 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function, gates off core cones number at least |E-D|+tau+mc-1
